answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to bring the lone active opponent into firing geometry by sustaining a descending left turn from north toward west, where B0100 was approaching; the ammunition decrease and new A0100 missile near the end support attack commitment, after which the turn continues briefly.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to remain difficult to engage while opening northward lateral separation, using repeated high-bank heading corrections while preserving high speed; B0100 stayed west-southwest and its missile remained behind to the west as A0200 curved from northeast toward north without expending a missile.
